# tenzir_organization (Data Source)

An organization, looked up by ID or slug. Needs `Organization.read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenzir_organization" "acme" {
  slug = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The organization ID. Set this or `slug`.
- `slug` (String) The organization's name in URLs. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `icon_url` (String) The URL of the organization icon.
- `member_count` (Number) How many users are members.
- `name` (String) The display name.
